name: Fortune Oriental Company Limited
summary: Fortune Oriental Company Limited, with its headquarters located in New Taipei City, Taiwan, is engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of various lighting solutions throughout the Taiwanese market. The company's product line includes a wide array of LED lighting applications such as bulbs, tubes, recessed fixtures, ring lamps, floodlights, high patio lights, and downlights. They also provide specialized T-bar office lighting, semi-spiral bulbs, and circulation fans, which are primarily deployed in commercial environments like indoor spaces, outdoor illumination, and retail display areas. In addition to its lighting business, Fortune Oriental Company Limited offers multimedia information products catering to commercial sectors such as audio-visual entertainment, information management, educational platforms, public relations, and general lifestyle applications. The company is also active in the international import and export trade of these multimedia goods. Previously known as Infodisc Technology Co., Ltd., the firm officially adopted the name Fortune Oriental Company Limited in June 2016.
